title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Economic Blocks and Their Implication
description: Learn economic integration and gain a comprehensive understanding of its implications on global markets.
longDescription: This professional certificate course overviews economic integration and its implications, covering regional trade blocks such as the European Union (EU), Latin American Integration Association (LAIA), ASEAN, NAFTA, EFTA, and SAARC. Participants will gain a thorough understanding of the workings of these economic blocks, their activities, and their impact on global markets and regional economic integration in the Americas. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with a comprehensive knowledge of the various trade blocks and their implications in the global economy.
